hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && d=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' '); u=$(git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$d" -gt 0 ] || [ "$u" -gt 0 ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Deploy pending: $d uncommitted file(s), $u unpushed commit(s) — push to main to auto-deploy app.serpsquad.com\"}"; fi
